articles.title: FIFA 2026 World Cup Final Halftime Show Lineup Includes Justin Bieber, Madonna And BTS
articles.description: For the first time ever, Justin Bieber, Madonna, BTS and more will headline the 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show. Here's the full lineup of performers and special guests set to appear.
